facts.fact: 圣诞清晨：Lizzie 拖着鼓鼓的长袜冲进卧室——先不吃巧克力，先去找爸爸。
facts.anchor: ‘I’ve got to find my daddy first.’

facts.fact: 树下发现：Jack 躺在她家圣诞树下的地毯上——圣诞老人的礼物原来在这里。
facts.anchor: Hardly able to breathe, she tiptoed to the top of the stairs and peeped down, a frown touching her brows as she saw Jack sprawled on the carpet under her Christmas tree, talking softly to Lizzie who was sitting on him, giggling with excitement.

facts.fact: 来真的：他说这次不是玩 Weddings 游戏——一句「Bryony Hunter, will you marry me?」配上银纸包着的钻戒。
澄清动机：她以为他是为孩子妥协，他说「我做这事是为我自己，也为你」。
facts.anchor: ‘I did it for me. And for you.’

facts.fact: 告白完成：他终于说出「我爱你」——还自嘲想明白得太慢。
facts.anchor: ‘I’m marrying you because I love you,’

facts.fact: 家的定义：失踪那晚他回到自己的房子想通——家与漂亮房子无关，与「你」有关。
facts.anchor: Home for me is where you are, Bryony, and it always has been.

facts.fact: 双向确认：他也爱了她一辈子——只是把婚姻和灾难划了等号，不敢拿她们冒险。
facts.anchor: ‘And I’ve loved you for ever, too.

facts.fact: 环形收尾：Lizzie 已写好明年的信——一个妹妹；愿望线闭环、系列感拉满。
facts.anchor: For Christmas next year, I really really want a baby sister.
